snippets.text: It contains a great deal that Sun Tzŭ did not write, and very little indeed of what he did.
Here is a fair specimen, taken from the opening sentences of chapter 5:—
This text is a scholarly examination of how Sun Tzŭ's 'Art of War' has been translated and transmitted.
It combines analytical rigor with a critical view of earlier renderings, offering insight into editorial challenges.
The tone is learned and exacting, suited to listeners interested in textual history and translation theory.
The author is recorded as Sunzi, active in the 6th century B.C.
Further biographical details are not available.
